messages:
nate: Pushed a docs PR for quota + pricing updates: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4912. Main goals: clarify per-second quotas, show migration examples, and update SDK snippets for v2. Need a quick UX + accuracy pass.

ashley: skimmed it. Nice layout. One thought: the term 'compute units' shows up only in the pricing page; docs should mention it when explaining quota tiers so users can map spend -> units. Left a couple inline comments.

dina: agree with ashley. Also the examples currently show the Python snippet first; product asked for JS-first in quickstarts. I'll swap the order.

kevin: noticed the dashboard link under "Usage analytics" points to the old path `/dashboards/usage-old`. New path is `/console/analytics/usage`. I'll PR a link fix. Also the rollout of quota headers needs an example of both `X-Redwood-Plan` and the fallback behavior when header is missing.

nate: good catch on the header. Can we add a small snippet demonstrating fallback logic in the client? Something like: if header absent, server maps to 'free-tier'.

sam: preview is live: https://deploy-preview.redwood.dev/4912. There's a mobile wrapping issue with the tiers table (long plan names push layout). I added a responsive CSS suggestion in the PR comments.

ashley: another nit: rate-limit sample shows `RetryAfter` (camelcase) in the response. Per spec it should be `Retry-After`. Also we should show an example of a 503 fallback when both quota pool and burst are exhausted.

dina: for the migration example, propose a short conversion table instead of prose. e.g.:

OLD quota | interpretation
600 req / minute -> 10 req / sec + burst=60

I'll format that as a code block so readers can copy.

kevin: infra approves burst semantics as documented. One addition: note that burst credits are consumed per-customer and replenish at a steady rate; small wording tweak to avoid implying instantaneous refill.

nate: added the refill wording change. Also included a mini SDK JS example (v2) showing header usage and a fallback: 

```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-sdk';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });

// attach plan header when the product has a paid plan
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-large', prompt: 'hi', headers: { 'X-Redwood-Plan': 'pro-annual' } });

// fallback: omit header, server treats request as 'free' plan
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-large', prompt: 'hi' });
```

sam: CI ran and flagged one broken anchor in the billing faq (#usage-credit-repurchase). I fixed the anchor and re-ran linkcheck. All good now.

docs-bot: Spellcheck, linkcheck, and responsiveness tests passed for PR #4912. Merge scheduled for 14:00 UTC.

ashley: will run localization smoke tests after merge. If anything pops, ping me in #l10n.

nate: thanks y'all. After merge I'll follow up with a short note in the changelog and a pointer to the migration snippet in the SDK migration guide. :rocket:
